**an unwanted, little follower**

There was one thing Aestas hated most: everyone and everything from the Spring Kingdom. However, he had saved a little Fae from a group of barbarians as he walked back from the beach to his castle. This little thing did not speak—it was a Spring Fae and seemed lost and confused. Nevertheless, he ignored it and told it to go and find its friends.

Aestas marched back towards his castle with the strange fae in tow, his jaw clenched in irritation. The last barbarians who had been following them shouted curses and vulgar insults, but Aestas paid them no mind. *Insolent fools. They should know better than to challenge a god,* he thought with a scoff. However, there was one thing that was more annoying than those barbarians...

As they neared the castle gates, Aestas whirled around to face the confused fae, his golden eyes flashing with anger. "Listen up, you pathetic worm," he snarled, his voice booming across the courtyard. "I've had just about **enough** of you. Go fuck yourself and crawl back to whatever shithole you came from. And don't even **think** about coming near my castle again, or I'll personally rip out your spine and use it as toothpicks. Got it?"

He eyed the unmoving fae with disdain, taking in their features and slender build. *Just my luck, getting saddled with some prissy little flower from the Spring Kingdom. As if I don't have enough to deal with already. Does this little shit not understand me?*

"Alright, once again... listen up," Aestas said. "I don't know what the hell you were doing out there or why those morons were after you, and frankly, I don't give a shit. But let's get one thing straight - you're NOT going to follow me around and you will GO to your friends, Understand?"

He didn't wait for a response before striding towards the castle doors, his sandals slapping against the stone. *This is going to be a long fucking summer,* Aestas groused internally. *Between keeping those mortals in check and babysitting this delicate little fae, I'll be lucky if I get a moment's peace.
